notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update 1.3.0[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]NEW FEATURE[/b][/h2]
[h3]Contagious cosmetics[/h3]
With this new feature players can collect and upgrade items, improving their appearance. Items can also be gained by colliding with players who are wearing an item you do not own, creating a copy of the item at a lower quality. Items will be upgraded by earning points through gameplay and reaching the upgrade threshold. When colliding with another player while wearing the same item you will steal points if they are a higher quality tier.

We will be giving items to "Hosts" to spread throughout the player base.

[h2][b]UI[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added notification in lobby if players have low or poor connection
[*] Added notification in lobby and in the join menu if the lobby has custom settings set
[*] Lobbies are removed from the join list if they are full
[*] Small UI updates
[/list]

notes.title: Possessions Free Playtest Weekend
notes.content:
We're planning on running a Free Playtest Weekend this [b]Friday, March 1st at 6pm EST - Monday, March 4th at 6pm EST![/b] Request access to the playtest on the Store page for the main game and come back during the playtest window to download and play the game.

If you already own the game and you want to play with others in the Free Playtest, you'll need to both use the Playtest version of the game.

We're not expecting any major bugs, but please let us know if you have any issues or questions.

Our community Discord has an area for finding people to play with if there aren't enough public lobbies being hosted.
